Pipeline design

Quality signals at a glance

01
Quality gate first

Lint and strict TypeScript checks complete before API execution.

02
Isolated local target

Every shard starts its own pinned Restful Booker Docker service.

03
Actionable defects

Known bugs stay visible without keeping the pipeline permanently red.

04
Failure evidence retained

Traces remain attached to their workflow run and are excluded from public Pages.

Expected-failure policy

Green does not hide known bugs

Confirmed defects use Playwright’s expected-failure marker. Reproduction keeps CI green; an unexpected pass fails the run so the defect record can be reviewed.
